headline: A touchdown for the Colts
what_happened: J.Taylor ran the ball 24 yards into the end zone for a touchdown, which is the way a team scores 6 points.
who: J.Taylor made the play for the Colts.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs as it puts them behind on the scoreboard. It increased the Colts' chances of winning by 9 percentage points.
